user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve Centre County census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate census tract polygon dataset covering Centre County for the hospital containment join.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the available census tract polygon dataset covering Centre County. Treat the result as a candidate and validate its spatial coverage, polygon geometry, CRS, and tract identifier field at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospitals to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point coordinates into the census tract layer CRS so the spatial join can use compatible coordinate systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector artifact from its observed EPSG:4326 CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve the hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join that attaches the containing tract identifier to each hospital.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially join the reprojected hospital points to the retrieved census tract polygons using the containment relationship. Retain each hospital feature and attach the tract identifier field identified from the tract candidate schema at runtime. Do not assume a field name before runtime schema grounding.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census tract candidate must cover Centre County and the hospital locations.
The retrieved tract candidate must be available in a format accepted by the spatial join worker.
The reprojected hospital points and retrieved tract polygons must have compatible CRSs before the spatial join.
Hospital point and census tract polygon geometries must be valid and non-empty for containment matching.
The tract candidate must contain a field representing the requested tract identifier, and that field must be grounded from runtime schema evidence before configuring the join output.
